GEOGRAPHY — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #10
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture.
   C. Say Agriculture never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Agriculture as rumours only.

2. Which statement about Introduction to Geography is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Geography.
   B. Treat Introduction to Geography as rumours only.
   C. Explain Introduction to Geography with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Introduction to Geography never happens in Kenya.

3. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Littering in markets

4. Which statement about Energy is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Energy.
   B. Explain Energy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Energy as rumours only.
   D. Say Energy never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   C. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.

6. Which statement about Mining is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Mining.
   B. Explain Mining with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Mining never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Mining as rumours only.

7. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Name the president
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

8. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   B. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.

9. Which statement about Vulcanicity is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Vulcanicity with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Vulcanicity.
   C. Say Vulcanicity never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Vulcanicity as rumours only.

10. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nakuru
   C. Nairobi
   D. Mombasa

11. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Avoid saving forever

12. Which statement about Rocks is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Rocks.
   B. Say Rocks never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Rocks with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Rocks as rumours only.

13. Which statement about Folding is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Folding as rumours only.
   B. Explain Folding with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Folding.
   D. Say Folding never happens in Kenya.

14. Which statement about Industry is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Industry as rumours only.
   B. Say Industry never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Industry.
   D. Explain Industry with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

15. Which statement about Earthquakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Earthquakes.
   B. Treat Earthquakes as rumours only.
   C. Explain Earthquakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Earthquakes never happens in Kenya.

16. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   B. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   D. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Folding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Vulcanicity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Earthquakes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Agriculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Mining and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Energy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Industry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Geography and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Map Reading and Interpretation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Statistical Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
